failed_checks.reason: Draft 1 used the terms 'LLM', 'vector database', and 'hallucination' in the How-it-works and Recap sections without ever defining them in plain language. A learner with no prior AI background would not know what these mean.

Draft 1 described the leave-policy scenario in a single summarizing sentence ('the AI retrieves the relevant paragraph and answers') instead of walking through it as a numbered, step-by-step example a beginner could trace.

changes_made: Added an explicit plain-language definition for 'LLM' the first time it is used ('a program trained on huge amounts of text to understand and write language').
Added an explicit plain-language definition for 'vector database' framed as a 'smart filing cabinet' analogy, contrasted with Ctrl+F search.
Added an explicit plain-language definition for 'hallucination' with a concrete description ('when an AI confidently states something false as if it were true').

Rewrote the worked example as a numbered 4-step walkthrough (Search -> Retrieve -> Combine -> Generate) with a concrete document, question, and answer at each step, plus an explicit 'Without RAG' contrast to make the value of retrieval visible.
